name: late_join_gap
_comment: T557 (chaos_10): client_2 leaves and rejoins, its late-join load stretched to 8 s (late_ready_delay_s, on both: process names and roster slots may swap, M2.4); meanwhile the server kills client_1's mech and client_1's bot picks its next one -- both inside client_2's gap between its hello (the late state) and being connected. Before T557 those broadcasts never reached it: the new mech was missing there (Node not found RPC errors, parity spawn), the death unseen (parity), and snapshots by team index landed on the wrong mechs.
